messages.bodyText:
Dear *Piyush* *Sir,*


Greetings from the Indian Institute of Management, Ranchi!


I, *Alok Kumar*, am reaching out on behalf of the Corporate
Relations and Placement Committee of *IIM Ran**chi.*

It is with great pleasure and excitement that we extend an invitation to
*Docdril* to engage with us through a range of campus activities,
including *Leadership
Talks*, *Live Projects* and participation in the *Summer Internship* and *Final
Placement drive* for the academic year *2026-27*, starting in *August 2026*.

Backed by a distinguished *16+ years* legacy of academic rigour and
industry engagement, IIM Ranchi offers flagship programs in *MBA, MBA-HR,
and MBA-Business Analytics*. Ranked *18th among all B-schools in India
*and *10th
among IIMs* in the *NIRF 2025 rankings*, the institute is dedicated to
nurturing innovative, responsible leaders equipped to excel in today’s
rapidly evolving global landscape.

*Please find below key* *insights into IIM Ranchi's three **distinguished*
*programs:*
[image: Flagship Program.png]

*The following are some of the campus engagement avenues at IIM Ranchi:  *

[image: Campus Engagement Avenues (2).png]

Some of the prominent associations of IIM Ranchi are as follows:
[image: Prominent Associates.png]

To provide a comprehensive overview of our placement performance and
recruiter engagements, please find our *audited* *Final Placement Report
(2025-26)*
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/media/2024/01/Audited-Final-Placement-Report-2025-26-compressed.pdf>
 and *Summer Internship Report (2025-26)*
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/media/2026/06/IIM-Ranchi-Summer-Internship-Placement-Report-2025-2026.pdf>
, offering additional insights into our placement ecosystem and corporate
partnerships.

Our *Placement Season 2026-27* is tentatively scheduled to commence in *August
2026*. However, depending on your hiring requirements and role
specifications, we would be happy to explore suitable avenues of engagement
and accommodate accordingly.

We are highly enthusiastic about establishing a long-term, mutually
beneficial association with *Docdril*. Should this be of interest, we would
be delighted to connect at a time that is convenient for you to discuss
potential collaboration opportunities further.

Please let me know if you need any further details. I will be more than
happy to coordinate with you.
Looking forward to your positive response!

*Thanks and Regards,*


*Alok Kumar*
Executive Member

Corporate Relations & Placement Committee
MBA, Class of 2026-28

*Indian Institute of Management** Ranchi*



Mobile: +91 9508777627 <+91%2095087%2077627>

*Email <alok.kumari23@iimranchi.ac.in>** | **LinkedIn
<http://linkedin.com/in/alok-kumar0607>** | **IIM Ranchi Website
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/>*

*Celebrating 16 Years of Excellence in Management Education*


*Thanks and Regards,*


*Alok Kumar*
Executive Member

Corporate Relations & Placement Committee
MBA, Class of 2026-28

*Indian Institute of Management** Ranchi*



Mobile: +91 9508777627

<http://linkedin.com/in/alok-kumar0607>** | **IIM Ranchi Website
<https://iimranchi.ac.in/>*

*Celebrating 16 Years of Excellence in Management Education*

Dear Piyush Sir,


Greetings from the Indian Institute of Management, Ranchi!


I, Alok Kumar, am reaching out on behalf of the Corporate Relations and Placement Committee of IIM Ranchi.

It is with great pleasure and excitement that we extend an invitation to Docdril to engage with us through a range of campus activities, including Leadership Talks, Live Projects and participation in the Summer Internship and Final Placement drive for the academic year 2026-27, starting in August 2026.

Backed by a distinguished 16+ years legacy of academic rigour and industry engagement, IIM Ranchi offers flagship programs in MBA, MBA-HR, and MBA-Business Analytics. Ranked 18th among all B-schools in India and 10th among IIMs in the NIRF 2025 rankings, the institute is dedicated to nurturing innovative, responsible leaders equipped to excel in today’s rapidly evolving global landscape.

Please find below key insights into IIM Ranchi's three distinguished programs:



The following are some of the campus engagement avenues at IIM Ranchi:  


Some of the prominent associations of IIM Ranchi are as follows:



To provide a comprehensive overview of our placement performance and recruiter engagements, please find our audited Final Placement Report (2025-26) and Summer Internship Report (2025-26), offering additional insights into our placement ecosystem and corporate partnerships.

Our Placement Season 2026-27 is tentatively scheduled to commence in August 2026. However, depending on your hiring requirements and role specifications, we would be happy to explore suitable avenues of engagement and accommodate accordingly.

We are highly enthusiastic about establishing a long-term, mutually beneficial association with Docdril. Should this be of interest, we would be delighted to connect at a time that is convenient for you to discuss potential collaboration opportunities further.    

Please let me know if you need any further details. I will be more than happy to coordinate with you.

Looking forward to your positive response!

Thanks and Regards,

Hi Arushi,

I saw Docdril blends cinematic video editing with AI automation for brands.
Given your mix of storytelling, UGC, and campaign work, I thought this
might be relevant.

I’m Quentin from Ai cinematic videos and short films. I help creative teams
turn campaign ideas into premium visual concepts fast, so clients can pitch
stronger without a full shoot budget.

For a team like Docdril, I can map out 3 cinematic mockup angles for your
current brand campaigns in 15 minutes, or I’ll keep it to a simple written
outline you can use internally.

Open to a short reply and I’ll send the outline?

Best,
Quentin

messages.subject: Why Automation Is Essential for Modern Business
messages.snippet: Automation is becoming increasingly important because it helps businesses save time, reduce repetitive manual work, minimize errors, and imp
messages.bodyText: Automation is becoming increasingly important because it helps businesses save time, reduce repetitive manual work, minimize errors, and improve overall productivity. By automating routine processes, teams can focus more on strategy, creativity, customer relationships, and other high-value activities while maintaining greater consistency and efficiency. Whether it is managing leads, sending follow-ups, handling data, generating reports, or streamlining internal workflows, automation allows a business to scale faster without increasing operational workload at the same rate. In today’s competitive environment, adopting automation is not just about convenience—it is a key advantage for working smarter, responding faster, and building a more efficient and scalable business.
